name: Gather Spark
description: Gather loose light from the air into a hand-sized core and hold it ready for the next move.

name: Bead Burst
description: Throw a bead of dense light that bursts in a small flash when it strikes.

name: Core Knock
description: Tap the target with a fist wrapped round the held core so the light bruises on contact.

name: Pale Guard
description: Spread the core into a pale disc before the body that takes one blow and then thins away.

name: Glow Slip
description: Fade into the glare of the core and step out of it a pace to the side.

name: Lumen Lance
description: Stretch the core into a narrow lance of light and drive it through a guard into the arm behind.

name: Light Press
description: Press the held core against the target and bear down on their qi until their arm sags.

name: Warm Ray
description: Loose a ray with enough heat in it to redden the skin and make the target flinch.

name: Sear Beam
description: Hold a hot beam on a point beside the target to keep them from stepping into it.

name: Focus Mote
description: Squeeze the light in the hand to a single bright mote so every ray after it burns hotter.

name: Scorch Palm
description: Close a glowing palm on the target's wrist so the held heat blisters the skin.

name: Searing Needle
description: Send a needle of white heat through a seam in the guard to burn one joint.

name: Beam Sweep
description: Swing a broad beam across the front so that everyone in its path is burned and forced back.

name: Lens Gleam
description: Curve the light before the eyes like a lens to bring far figures close and sharp.

name: Far Glint
description: Send a glint along a bent path and read what it touches beyond a corner.

name: Dazzle Cloud
description: Breathe out a cloud of drifting glitter that dazzles the eyes of everyone in front.

name: Angle Glint
description: Throw a glint at a wall so it bends off and strikes the target from the side.

name: Bent Guard
description: Bend the light round the forearm so a blow slides off at the wrong angle.

name: Glass Step
description: Shift the body a pace to where the bent light shows it to be.

name: Refract Read
description: Read the qi held in a body through the way light bends around it.

name: Refract Shot
description: Split one shot into a true beam and a false glimmer so the target guards the wrong line.

name: Lamp Touch
description: Rest a glowing hand on an ally's wound and let the lamp warm the torn flesh.

name: Calm Pulse
description: Send a calm pulse of light through the user's own body to ease pain and slow a racing heart.

name: Lamp Shield
description: Raise the lamp before a wounded ally and let its light turn aside stray blows.

name: Tonic Beam
description: Pass a thin beam into an ally's back to bring colour to the face and strength to the legs.

name: Purge Lamp
description: Pass a clean white lamp over a poisoned wound to draw the taint out of an ally's blood.

name: Lamp Mend
description: Hold a steady lamp over a deep cut until the edges draw together and the bleeding stops.

name: Burnish Ward
description: Polish the surface of the guard until it shines and the glare turns weak blows aside.

name: Glint Parry
description: Meet an incoming strike with a flash on the forearm and knock it off line.

name: Bright Roll
description: Roll clear of a heavy blow inside a flash so the foe loses the body in the glare.

name: Dazzle Check
description: Flash into the face of a rushing foe to check the rush for a breath.

name: Guard Glimmer
description: Hold a ring of faint light round the body and feel the first touch of any approach.

name: Radiant Plate
description: Harden the light into a broad plate that stops blows and sheds sharp edges to the side.

name: Return Flash
description: Catch a thrown missile in the plate and send its force back as a hard flash at the thrower.

name: Pulse Dart
description: Pulse a small dart of light from the knuckle that flies straight and fast.

name: Blink Step
description: Blink two paces forward on a pulse of light with the guard still up.

name: Hasten Glow
description: Wake a glow in the legs that quickens each step for a short run.

name: Narrow Streak
description: Pull the light into a narrow streak and fire it through a gap in the guard.

name: Triple Beam
description: Loose three beams in quick turn at the head and both knees of one target.

name: Chase Streak
description: Follow the beam in flight and arrive with a fist as it lands on the target.

name: Wash Glow
description: Wash an ally's scrapes in a pale glow that cleans the skin and speeds the closing.

name: Pale Wash
description: Wash an ally in a pale cooling light that clears sweat and weariness from the limbs.

name: Clear Sheen
description: Hold a clear sheen before the body that turns aside weak blows and spitting flame.

name: White Palm
description: Strike with a palm of cold white light that numbs the point of contact.

name: Quiet Flash
description: Flash without sound at the edge of sight so the target turns toward the wrong side.

name: Soothing Ray
description: Pass a soothing ray over an ally's burns to cool the skin and ease the sting.

name: Taint Sear
description: Burn poison and rot from an ally's wound with clean white light and spare the sound flesh.

name: Bright Mind
description: Drive a clear pulse of light through an ally's head to lift the fog of a minor qi backlash.
